meaning: An exception of a planning run (shortage inside lead time, below safety stock, above maximum, supplier minimums, container underfilled, stock expiring, firmed order overdue, parameter missing); owned by the planning owner when the node is made in production, otherwise by the buyer; closed when a run no longer raises it (ADR-0024 rule 21; ADR-0031 rule 17; ADR-0042 rule 7).
A work center overloaded over a contiguous range; one item per work center and range, buckets as evidence (ADR-0036 rule 11).
A pick confirmed short of its quantity (ADR-0023 rule 21).
A receipt whose putaway found no target bin (ADR-0023 rule 21).
A reservation canceled by a physical fact such as damage or a count shortage (ADR-0023 rules 12, 21).
An approved change proposal whose execution failed with a non-retryable error; resolved by resubmitting or canceling it (ADR-0029 rule 3).
A held event delivery whose failure matters to the business and whose consumer has no kind of its own; resolved when the delivery is retried or skipped (ADR-0013 rule 8).
An accepted e-invoice whose posting failed; resolved by Complete<Type>Posting (ADR-0028 rule 7).
An accepted e-invoice whose issue date is outside the regime window (ADR-0028 rule 8).
An e-invoice the provider or authority rejected; the document is back in draft (ADR-0028 rule 7).
Issuance held by an e-invoice outage; resolved when the delivery succeeds (ADR-0028 rule 10).

An owner of schedules, intakes, workflows, policy rules or open work items was deactivated or lost rights; what they own is suspended or reassigned (ADR-0017 rule 12; ADR-0042 rule 7; ADR-0043 rule 11).
An incoming message not matched to exactly one partner (ADR-0019 rule 15).
A partner suspected to duplicate another by name, tax ID or e-mail; never merged automatically (ADR-0019 rules 4, 19).
A data subject request (access, correction, deletion) with its legal due date (ADR-0019 rule 10).
An attachment the scanner rejected; its bytes were deleted and links removed; owned by its uploader (ADR-0038 rule 14; ADR-0042 rule 7).
A production order change or cancellation left an external operation's purchase line to review (ADR-0037 rule 4).
A tax line's deductibility condition is not yet met; resolved by the system when the condition is met or fails (ADR-0041 rule 14; ADR-0053 rules 3-4).
A tax line's deductibility fell by a condition_failed adjustment; for a person to review (ADR-0041 rule 14; ADR-0053 rules 3-4).
A document or change proposal waiting for approval; resolved by Approve, Reject, a new version, Cancel or Delete (ADR-0042 rule 17; ADR-0043 rule 13).

Unconfirmed auto-posts of one policy rule in one confirmation window (auto_post.confirmation_cadence: the posting period by default, or the ISO week or business date), due at the window's end; resolved by ConfirmAutoPost once all are confirmed (ADR-0029 rule 13; ADR-0043 rule 14; ADR-0065 rule 7).
A run a person or schedule started without an exception; claimed by the run at its start, owned by the person it acts for, resolved when it ends; no agent type may declare it (ADR-0042 rule 11).
A close job, revaluation, import chunk or tax adjustment that a policy rule denied or sent for approval (ADR-0043 rule 5).
The cost estimate of a new configured item could not be computed (a component without a price); closed when an estimate for the item is released (ADR-0046 rule 14).
A stock return left an order line's invoiced net above its delivered net; closed when a sales_return credits the difference (ADR-0047 rules 7, 20).
A return to the supplier left an order line's invoiced net above its received net; closed when a purchase_return records the supplier's credit (ADR-0047 rules 15, 20).
A bank statement line the matching cascade could not match; closed by the system when it is matched or ignored with a reason (ADR-0048 rule 9; ADR-0042 rule 1).

Agent runs of one type stopped on one date by a budget, a time limit, invalid output, a provider outage, a diverged resume or a repeated crash; one item per agent type, outcome and date (open_key <agent_type>:<outcome>:<business date>), the runs as evidence; owned by the human the first raising run acted for (ADR-0050 rules 17, 55; ADR-0042 rule 7).

A daily agent budget of the company tripped its circuit breaker (open_key <agent_type>:<business date> for an agent type's limits, company:<business date> or installation:<business date> for the caps); runs wait until the next business date and the work stays with people (ADR-0050 rules 24, 55).
An agent run collected three denials and was stopped, a signal of injected instructions (ADR-0050 rule 33; ADR-0017 rule 8).

An inbound e-mail whose sender authentication passed, matched to exactly one partner automatically or by MatchInteraction, for a person or the quotation agent; renamed from inbound_message (ADR-0052 rule 15; ADR-0051 rule 14; ADR-0019 rule 15).

A stored incoming supplier e-invoice record waiting to become a purchase invoice, for a person or the purchase invoice agent; raised by tax in the transaction of ImportEInvoiceRecord or of the e-invoice add-on's intake (ADR-0051 rule 20).
An assisted agent type's 30-day agreement fell 10 points below its workflow threshold; a person decides whether to move it back to shadow (ADR-0051 rule 5).

Two rows of a draft import batch look like the same record, by key or by the data migration agent's judgement; never merged automatically; owned by the batch's creator (ADR-0051 rule 27; ADR-0044 rule 15; ADR-0042 rule 7).

An assisted agent type runs as shadow because its version behavior or a seat model differs from the promoted ones; one item per company and agent type (open_key the agent type); resolved when it is promoted again or its mode is lowered (ADR-0050 rule 14).
An open complaint of a customer; dunning skips the customer while it is open; resolved by CloseComplaint (ADR-0052 rules 20, 21).
A follow-up task; its work item holds the task's state; resolved by the assignee, superseded by a corrected task, or resolved as erased (ADR-0052 rules 19, 25).

A delivery attempt the mail server refused, or whose outcome stayed unknown; the message is back in approved; resolved when it closes, is updated back to draft or is canceled; never resent blindly (ADR-0052 rule 28).
A mailbox whose intake failed several times in a row (credentials, server), for its owner_user_id; resolved by the next successful intake (ADR-0052 rule 12).

A data subject request a person created or an agent drafted; a person verifies the requester and identifies the data subject; resolved by the UpdateDataSubjectRequest that sets both. Intake never classifies messages (ADR-0019 rule 10; ADR-0052 rule 24).
In the small-company mode, the first segregation exception of a posting period raises it; the owner reviews the period's exceptions and resolves it by ConfirmSegregationReview (ADR-0054 rule 20).
An upgrade held back permissions that would break segregation mode block or the small-company bound; resolved when no hold is held (ADR-0054 rule 9).

An approved sales order whose open demand rows sales put on credit hold; one item per order; resolved by ReleaseCreditHold, or by the system when the hold is cleared because the exposure fell under the limit (ADR-0047 rule 18).

A tax adjustment whose declaration date fell in a period that did not admit it, moved to the first day of the earliest later period that does; for a person to review the return (ADR-0041 rule 13; ADR-0012 rule 5, notes).

An extraction without a valid deterministic record, or under full review, waits for a person on the verification screen; also resolved by CancelDocumentExtraction. Owner: the requester, or for a mailbox the purpose's role (role:accountant for supplier invoices, role:sales_clerk for inquiry lines). Never raised for an XML whose e-invoice record was imported. The agent type document_reader may first add vision values where the seat is usable (ADR-0057 rules 4, 11, 23, 33).
A verified supplier-invoice extraction without an e-invoice record; the purchase invoice agent 1.1.0 drafts the invoice from its confirmed fields (ADR-0057 rule 26).
A quarantined incoming e-invoice record was superseded by a record with the same key and a passed signature (ADR-0057 rule 25).

The XML extractions of one mailbox and receipt date that the quarantine cap for messages not matched to a partner kept from import; resolved when each listed extraction is imported with ImportEInvoiceRecord, or when the owner closes the item (ADR-0057 rule 25).

The quarantined incoming e-invoice records of one sender in one mailbox on one business date, records sharing a key shown together; the one human task for them; resolved when each is confirmed or superseded (ADR-0057 rule 25).
A record with a passed signature arrived for a key held by a confirmed, formerly quarantined record; both stay without agent runs until an accountant resolves the conflict (ADR-0057 rule 25).
The proposal items a product engineering run drafted were executed and bound; its continuation re-runs checks and the estimate and drafts the release proposal (ADR-0062 rules 3, 14).
An item proposal that draft structures refer to was rejected, canceled or expired; the drafts stay unreleasable until a person chooses an item or proposes again (ADR-0062 rule 14).

A work item an automation rule raised, with the rule's text; owner and due date named by the rule (a user, a role template, the subject's document owner or a decision table output); evidence links the triggering subject (ADR-0058 rule 8).
An in-app notice an automation rule sent to people inside the company, acknowledged by resolving it; e-mail and push stay after Phase 1 (ADR-0058 rule 8; ADR-0040 rule 14).

A rule was disabled by its circuit breaker (owner: the rule's owner) or because its owner's account was disabled or last assignment ended (owner: company_owner, who reassigns it); the executions are evidence (ADR-0058 rules 9, 16).
An upgrade check deactivated an artifact; owner the artifact's owner; the findings are evidence (ADR-0058 rule 25).
An upgrade check found a deprecated registry item in an active artifact; the artifact keeps working until the item is removed; owner the artifact's owner (ADR-0058 rule 25).

The monitor demoted an artifact version to shadow beyond its override or drift threshold and moved the pointer back; owner the artifact's owner; the snapshot and any outdated auto-post rule are evidence (ADR-0059 rule 21).

A release changed the function version of a tunable function; subject the re-evaluation (for core defaults it names the function and company); one item per owner, the owner in its key: the parameter set's owner (company_owner under core defaults) and each dependent auto-post rule's owner (ADR-0059 rule 4).

RunAutomationOwnerScopeCheck found a stored scope cell of a rule in force (branch, warehouse, level, team or department members, for an assignment granting the rule's read) that no new cell covers; owner the rule's owner; the item names the uncovered cells; one open item per rule; team and department churn raises such items, as expected (ADR-0058 rule 9).
The asker marked an analysis answer wrong; a person reruns the plan under their own rights and may save a corrected plan as an analysis example (ADR-0060 rules 21, 28).
A question abstained with out_of_coverage and the asker asked for the figure; collected as catalog backlog (ADR-0060 rule 24).

An upgrade introduced a setting whose core default changes behavior, or a behavior the company relied on now needs a setting or a permission; the item names the key, the old behavior and the new default (ADR-0063 rule 5).
The provider registry changed the region or terms reference of an endpoint under an active permission, which is suspended until a new permission is approved (ADR-0063 rule 14).
A rule reached automation.max_executions_per_rule_per_hour and recorded rate_limited executions; one per rule and business date (ADR-0063 rule 21).
A system posting under the rule was reversed or confirmed wrong; the rule version's evidence is outdated and later postings get human_post until a new version brings new evidence (ADR-0063 rule 10).

A posted purchase invoice is a suspected near duplicate under intake.duplicate.near_outcome review; its open item is blocked for payment until a person records not a duplicate with a reason, or cancels or reverses it (ADR-0063 rule 27).

A production order's open exceptions and action messages of the latest planning run (start overdue, overdue, expedite, postpone, cancel, reduce); one per order; closed when a run raises none (ADR-0064 rule 17).
An approved order has a component line with short or uncovered quantity within the readiness horizon, in every reservation mode; raised and closed by RunProductionOrderCheck (ADR-0064 rule 12).
Receipts reached the completion share and the operations are done, but the order is not technically complete; closed when it is or stops qualifying (ADR-0064 rules 12, 18).
An order in progress has had no posting for the stalled-days setting; closed when a posting arrives or it completes (ADR-0064 rules 12, 18).

The same variance driver persists over the feedback minimums; the item carries the code-computed statistics for a new revision or a lead-time proposal; RunProductionOrderCheck closes it when the driver no longer qualifies (ADR-0064 rules 12, 21).
An extraction of purpose shop_floor_report reached extracted or verified; the capture agent drafts from it, or a person keys the documents (ADR-0064 rule 19).
A production import row stayed a draft confirmation (auto-post off, a check result or a failed check); resolved when the draft is posted or canceled (ADR-0064 rule 25).

An external call's outcome stayed unknown for integrations.<provider>.max_unknown_rounds rounds of a settle delay and two status queries; the delivery is held and the document stays in issuing; resolved when the delivery is retried and records an outcome, is skipped, or the document is recalled (ADR-0013 rule 10 note; ADR-0028 rule 10 note).

The auto-post gateway decided require_human or reject for a draft version; names the first failed rule and its values (for example a price 5% above the order); resolved when the version is posted, canceled or replaced by a later version (ADR-0065 rules 3, 4).

Before go-live an implementer the owner acknowledged set a setting loosening without a second approver; the item lists every setup loosening with its old and new value, and reminds the owner while ui.post_review is on_exceptions and ui.post_review_max_amount is still 0; it shows on the close checklist while open without blocking the lock, and the owner resolves it after review (ADR-0067 rules 10, 11).
An inspection lot waits for results and a usage decision; resolved when the lot is submitted or canceled (ADR-0070 rule 8).
A certificate of analysis whose partner, item and lot code match no single open inspection lot; a person links or records it by hand (ADR-0070 rule 11).
A task or draft created for a usage decision was canceled or confirmed short, or the lot's source was reversed after the decision; lists the line and the shortfall (ADR-0070 rules 8, 15).
An open nonconformance; the trigger of work case kind nonconformance; resolved when it is closed or canceled (ADR-0070 rule 16).
A containment or corrective action of a nonconformance for the owner named on it, by its due date; open key: the nonconformance and the action kind (ADR-0070 rule 16).
A WO was blocked with a stop reason; closed by the system when the WO leaves blocked by StartOperation (ADR-0071 rule 18).
